errors.text_span: Стълбовете са разделени на два компонента – син, представляващ броя на продадените електрически автомобили, и оранжев, показващ процента от общия брой.
errors.evidence: The description states that the bars are 'divided into two components', which implies a stacked bar chart. The figure actually shows a grouped bar chart, with blue and orange bars placed side-by-side for each year.

The description of the vertical axis ('Брой автомобили') fails to mention that this scale only applies to the blue bars (absolute number of cars). It omits the crucial information that the orange bars represent a different unit (percentage) and are not measured against this axis, which could be misleading.

errors.text_span: докато стълбовете, показващи процента от общия брой, също показват тенденция на покачване, но с по-бавни темпове.
errors.evidence: The description makes a comparison of the rate of increase between the two data series ('but at a slower pace'), which is an interpretation forbidden by the prompt. The prompt explicitly states to avoid making comparisons or drawing conclusions.
